posts.text: Today is a victory for women and girls across America. To every woman who refused to be bullied into silence, thank you. Your courage made this possible. As the mother of daughters, I’ll never stop saying it: men do not belong in women’s sports or women’s spaces. Period.
posts.summary: Opposes transgender athletes in women's sports
